csv_scope_of_work: The Englewood Housing Authority (EHA) is accepting proposals for up to 50 Project-Based Vouchers (PBVs) under the Housing Choice Voucher Program for eligible housing developments located exclusively within the City of Englewood, New Jersey. EHA invites applications for newly constructed, existing, and rehabilitated housing projects that meet HUD eligibility requirements and EHA program priorities. Housing Assistance Payment (HAP) contracts may be awarded for an initial term of up to twenty (20) years, with one optional extension of up to an additional twenty (20) years.
